usedFor: Lingoes.ai works with language, and “Classify Text With LingoesAI Ready Model” labels a piece of text with a ready model.

bestTemplate.name: “Classify Text With LingoesAI Ready Model” in Lingoes.ai
bestTemplate.why: It labels text before a later step decides where it goes, so routing is not by hand.

watchOut: The action only labels text, so a person or a later step has to act on the label.
